title: Polynomial-Time Coin Construction
statement: For every bit string $z$, decode its pair, retain the $1$ bits of the second component in their original order, and combine this string with the word obtained by applying the fourfold length-limited iteration to the one-pass transducer output on the first component; then apply the unary multiplication construction to the resulting pair. This function is computable by a deterministic finite-state Turing machine in time $C(n+1)^c$ on every input of length $n$, for some natural numbers $C$ and $c$.
caveat: The supplied descriptions do not fully specify the transducer and unary multiplication construction.
